newsitem.title: FRANCE: European defence companies create tank weapon unit.
newsitem.headline: European defence companies create tank weapon unit.

text.p: France's Giat Industries, Germany's Rheinmetall Industrie AG and British Aerospace's Royal Ordnance unit announced on Thursday the creation of a joint subsidiary to develop a tank cannon.

The unit, to be called RGR Armament GmbH, will be held equally by the three companies and based in Ratingen, Germany. It will be charged with the development, production and commercialisation of a 140-millimetre canon and ammunition.
The weapon would be developed as part of the Future Main Tank Armament programme.

"This creation marks a significant step forward in European industrial cooperation for the development and production of defence materiel. RGR Armament will be able to serve as a basis for later cooperation in future technologies for cannons, tanks and munitions," the three companies said in a joint statement.
